prompts.name: lee_shh_up1
prompts.prompt: Upscale and restore image 1 into a sharp, high-resolution photo. Keep EVERYTHING exactly the same: the same man, identical face, squinting playful expression, glasses, finger on lips 'shh' gesture, hand, suit, red tie, name badge, the other man on the right, background market, framing and lighting. Only remove blur, JPEG artifacts and noise and add natural fine detail. Do not beautify, do not change faces or age, do not add or remove anything, no text, no logo, no watermark.
